text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: synth-check-eu-1 fired 3x within 5m -> HTTP 429 from canary probes. Incident ID: PAGERDUTY-INC-7834. Link: <https://pagerduty.example/INC-7834>
pagerduty-bot: Incident PAGERDUTY-INC-7834 assigned to oncall_maya (primary).
oncall_maya: acked, taking it. hitting dashboards now.
oncall_maya: quick snapshot — synth failure rate jumped from 0.4% -> 12% for eu region. failures are 429s, response body: `{"status":429,"detail":"rate limit exceeded","policy":"edge-per-ip"}`
liam_sre: i'm looking at the synth-runner logs, see a big fanout from synth-eu-[10..15] around 08:12 UTC. concurrency looks elevated.
oncall_maya: we rolled a probe-config change last night that increased `parallel_checks` from 5 -> 20 to speed up coverage. can we throttle back? :grimacing:
ashok_platform: pls don't rollback the deploy yet — we can throttle at runtime. patching configmap to set `parallel_checks=5` now.
oncall_maya: commands i'm about to run (patching config):
```bash
kubectl patch configmap synth-config -n infra --type merge -p '{"data":{"parallel_checks":"5"}}'
```
pagerduty-bot: Acknowledgement recorded: oncall_maya acknowledged PAGERDUTY-INC-7834.
emily_prodeng: checking product logs — no 5xx spikes from model endpoints. traces show successful calls; the only error is the 429 returned by CDN/edge before reaching our origin. likely upstream throttling.
jordan_support: we've had two support pings mentioning intermittent failures in the EU beta group, linking them now. customers seeing intermittent probe alerts in their dashboards.
liam_sre: sent message to CDN ops: "observed new 429s for synthetic canaries, looks like edge rate-limiting kicked in after policy change this morning. can you confirm?" CDN ops responded: "yes — new per-ip CORS/WAF rate policy deployed 07:50 UTC, we can add exceptions or route via fallback edge. opening vendor ticket TICKET-1221."
oncall_maya: immediate mitigation: reduce probe concurrency (done) + change probe routing to `eu-fallback` edge to avoid new rate limiter. applying route change now.
```bash
cat <<EOF | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: synth-routing
  namespace: infra
data:
  probe_route: "eu-fallback"
EOF
```
incident-bot: Probe routing change detected for canary set `eu-1` -> new route `eu-fallback`.
liam_sre: after throttle + routing, failures dropped back to baseline within ~90s. 429 error rate is now ~0.6% — close to previous noise level. :white_check_mark:
pagerduty-bot: PAGERDUTY-INC-7834 status: acknowledged -> monitoring. Severity downgraded to SEV3 (no customer-visible impact confirmed).
emily_prodeng: customer impact assessment: no API 5xx, no increased latencies for customer traffic; only synthetic checks were affected because probes originate from a limited set of IPs triggering vendor rate limits. Recommend updating runbook to handle CDN 429s by throttling and using fallback edge before PD escalation.
oncall_maya: creating ticket in #incidents-postmortem and adding interim remediation steps. will document timeline and the config diff.
jordan_support: drafting customer note (for affected beta customers): "We observed synthetic checks failing due to CDN edge rate-limiting. We've reduced probe concurrency and routed probes to a fallback edge. There is no impact to your production traffic. We are working with the CDN to remove the rule for our probe IPs."
ashok_platform: vendor ticket TICKET-1221 open; asked CDN to whitelist synth IP block for probe traffic. they replied: "we can do allowlist for your probe tags; ETA 2hrs after approval." scheduling follow-up.
liam_sre: taking over active watch for the next 2 hours, i'll correlate probe timestamps with CDN logs and produce a short root-cause draft. oncall_maya handing off — thanks, i'm off shift in 18m.
oncall_maya: handing off to liam_sre. good job team. adding label `synth-cdn-429` and `followup:whitelist` to the incident doc.
incident-bot: Reminder: if 429s reoccur after remediation, escalate to SEV2 and page oncall secondary.
emily_prodeng: suggested alert tuning: change PagerDuty trigger to require sustained 429 rate >5% for 10m before SEV2, and add a condition to ignore 429-only when origin 5xx==0. adding to runbook PR.
jordan_support: will send customer note after liam confirms root cause timeline.
liam_sre: note to self — actions: 1) correlate synth-eu IP usage, 2) confirm vendor whitelist, 3) measure false-positive rate change when concurrency is 5 vs 20, 4) propose permanent routing change or backoff logic in runner.
oncall_maya: closing my active ack. leaving summary in PD incident and #incidents-log. :white_check_mark:
pagerduty-bot: PAGERDUTY-INC-7834 - last update recorded. Incident owner: liam_sre. Monitoring continues until 3005009999 UTC.
